resources.string: Lets dcontrol inject touches, navigation keys and typing from the web console while you are mirroring, and lock the screen for find my phone. Input is only used on command; no screen content is read beyond the focused text field.
The Accessibility service is on. The web console can control the phone while mirroring.
Turn on the Accessibility service to let the web console tap, swipe and type, and to allow find-my-phone lock.
Sideloaded on Android 13+: open App info, tap the ⋮ menu and choose "Allow restricted settings" before enabling it in Accessibility.
